cohort: 138 patients who had undergone open fetal SB repair
finding: Subsequent pregnancies after open fetal SB repair had a 14% rate of early pregnancy loss, but all 29 pregnancies progressing beyond 20 gestational weeks resulted in live births without preterm births <34 weeks.
mod_finding: The risk of uterine dehiscence and rupture after open fetal spina bifida repair is similar to that reported after classical cesarean deliveries.
